description: Original synthetic English workplace passages; exploratory, not a held-out production benchmark. Binary relevance labels fixed before measurement.

documents.text: Budget review preparation: Priya needs headcount forecasts and supplier cost estimates for the quarterly finance meeting.
Last quarter budget review was cancelled. The old supplier spreadsheet is obsolete; do not use it for this quarter.
New employees receive a laptop, complete security training, and meet their assigned mentor during their first week.
When an employee leaves, revoke access, collect the laptop, and archive their work after manager approval.
The mobile release is blocked by a crash on login. Chen owns the fix and the shipping date moves to Friday.
Release notes describe new dark mode icons and translation updates. No login changes were included last month.
Disaster recovery restores the production database from encrypted nightly snapshots. Test restoration every month.
To reset a forgotten password, use the account recovery link and verify your identity with a second factor.
Business travel expenses require itemized receipts and manager approval within thirty days of returning.
Customers can request a refund within fourteen days of purchase. Support verifies the order number before reimbursement.
Annual leave requests must be submitted in the HR portal at least two weeks before the first day away.
If you are ill, notify your manager before your shift. Medical absence does not require two weeks advance notice.
The design review meets on Tuesday at ten in the Cedar room. Bring the updated prototype for accessibility feedback.
The old design review met on Monday in the Pine room. It has moved; use the current Tuesday invitation.
Report a suspected phishing message to the security team. Do not open attachments or share credentials.
Warehouse orders ship by courier on weekdays. International delivery usually takes seven business days.
The community garden needs watering twice a week. Tomatoes grow in the sunny raised beds near the gate.
For tomato soup, roast ripe tomatoes with garlic and onions, then blend with vegetable stock.
Visitors park in the north lot and collect a temporary badge from reception. Staff use the underground garage.
Guests connect to the visitor wireless network with a daily code issued by reception. Staff use certificate authentication.
Supplier invoices are paid sixty days after receipt. Include a purchase order reference and bank account details.
Requests to change supplier bank details must be verified by calling a known contact before any payment.
Support ticket personal data is deleted after ninety days unless a legal hold applies. Aggregated statistics are retained.
Project Atlas customer demo is due on Thursday. Sara will present the search prototype; metrics are due Wednesday.
